name: OrderDrinks
description: Go to the bartender or innkeeper, buy a round of drinks (one for the NPC, one for the player), and bring them back so the two can drink together. Only if the NPC is willing; they can refuse in character instead. The NPC decides who pays: the player, or the NPC as their treat.
note: Living World (MANTELLA_LIVING_WORLD=1). Then use Drink to drink yours. If the payer cannot afford it, the NPC comes back without drinks.

source.description: The NPC who goes to the bar.

bartender.description: The name of the bartender or innkeeper to buy from, if known. Leave empty and the NPC finds the innkeeper.

drink.description: What to order, one word: 'mead', 'ale' or 'wine'. Leave empty for mead.

payer.description: Who pays: 'player' (the player's gold, the default) or 'npc' (the NPC treats the player from their own gold).

prompt: If the player asks you to get drinks from the bartender, and you are willing to, begin your response with '{key}:'
